findings.title: Lithuanian message replaced with Italian text
findings.body: Line 101 in messages_lt.properties is now 'totpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:' which is Italian, not Lithuanian. The previous Lithuanian value was removed to strip HTML links, but the replacement was copied from the Italian bundle. Consequence: Lithuanian account UI will show Italian text to users.

findings.title: Lithuanian login message replaced with Italian text
findings.body: Line 71 in messages_lt.properties for login is now 'loginTotpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:' which is Italian, not Lithuanian. Same copy-paste error as the account bundle. Consequence: Lithuanian login UI shows Italian text.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese file contains Traditional Chinese
findings.body: Line 112 in messages_zh_CN.properties is 'totpStep1=In your mobile phone install one of the following apps' written with Traditional characters (手機, 應用程式) instead of Simplified (手机, 应用). The zh_CN bundle should use Simplified Chinese. Consequence: inconsistent locale, Simplified-Chinese users see Traditional wording.

findings.title: Anchor regex matches non-anchor tags starting with a
findings.body: In VerifyMessageProperties.java the pattern is '</?a[^>]*>'. Since 'a' is not followed by a word boundary, it matches '<address>', '<abbr>', '<article>', etc. as if they were anchors. Consequence: santizeAnchors() can strip or mis-report innocent tags, producing misleading 'Didn't find anchor tag' errors and hiding the real illegal-HTML violation.

findings.title: Dropped anchors are never reported
findings.body: In VerifyMessageProperties.java santizeAnchors() only loops over anchors found in the translation and checks they exist in English. It never checks the reverse: if English has an anchor and the translation omits it, the loop simply ends with no error. Consequence: a translation that drops a required link (breaking login/email flows) passes verification.

findings.title: Anchor error message lacks key and file
findings.body: In VerifyMessageProperties.java the anchor-mismatch branch adds "Didn't find anchor tag " + matcher.group() + " in original string" with no key name and no file name, unlike the Illegal HTML message which includes both. Consequence: when the verifier runs over hundreds of bundles, maintainers cannot locate which key/file failed without reproducing manually.

findings.title: Missing English reference aborts with RuntimeException
findings.body: In VerifyMessageProperties.java verifySafeHtml() catches IOException for the English reference file and throws new RuntimeException("unable to read file " + englishFile). verify() only declares MojoExecutionException for normal failures. Consequence: a missing or mis-mapped _en.properties file crashes the build with a stack trace instead of a collected verifier message, and aborts checking of all remaining files.
